children: Healthcare Triangle advanced its planned spin-off of Teyame AI Holdings by signing a Separation and Distribution Agreement and a Transition Services Agreement dated Sep 02 2026. The separation pact sets the framework for a pro rata distribution of a minority interest in Teyame to Healthcare Triangle shareholders, Nasdaq listing preparations, SEC reporting responsibilities, intercompany account treatment, and registration rights, with the distribution expected to be taxable. The transition services deal provides accounting, administrative and HR, legal and compliance, contracting, and IT support to Teyame beginning on the distribution date, with monthly billing and at-will termination mechanics. Healthcare Triangle will remain Teyame’s majority owner after the distribution.
